Jwt._comment: AccessTokenMinutes is one token's life, not the user's: a signed-in GUI rolls its token before it lapses (POST /auth/renew), so this bounds how long a leaked token keeps working. SessionMaxDays is the absolute ceiling on that rolling, measured from the actual sign-in.

AzureAd._comment: Entra single sign-on turns on automatically once TenantId and ClientId are set (in this file, an appsettings.Development/Production overlay, or ControlPlane__AzureAd__* environment variables). Local username/password sign-in is always available alongside it. Set Enabled to true to require SSO, or false to force it off even when credentials are present.

Dispatch._comment: The in-memory run dispatcher: a node's hand-out is a lease renewed by every poll (LeaseSeconds, at least twice LongPollSeconds); a poll with free slots is held open for up to LongPollSeconds; memory is diffed against the catalog journal every ReconcileSeconds; exactly one replica dispatches, arbitrated by an ownership lease of OwnershipTtlSeconds renewed every OwnershipRenewSeconds.

DataOps._comment: The data-operations surface: the standard warehouse maintenance actions (read-only measurements that emit review-ready SQL, never executing a mutating statement) and the old-versus-new baseline comparison used to prove the V3 migration. OFF by default; with Enabled false the operations are refused at the trust boundary and /dataops/capabilities reports the switch so the GUI explains instead of erroring. Turn on with ControlPlane__DataOps__Enabled=true. LinkedServers is the allowlist a comparison may name: a linked-server name becomes an identifier in generated SQL and a route into another estate, so it is configuration, never something a request chooses. Leave Databases empty to allow any database the linked server's own login can reach.

Assistant._comment: The GUI chat assistant: the same assistant core as the Slack bot, streamed to the GUI, with every agent run forwarding the calling user's own bearer to the MCP server. Off by default; the chat endpoints then report 'not configured' and the GUI explains instead of erroring. AzureFoundry mode needs Foundry ProjectEndpoint + ModelDeploymentName and runs keyless on the app identity; OpenAI/Anthropic modes take an ApiKey (a ${env:...}/${keyvault:...} reference or a literal). Foundry TranscriptionDeploymentName (e.g. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe) additionally enables server-side voice input.

QuestionGeneration._comment: Sync-time generation of 1-3 business questions per extracted PowerBI report visual (POWERAI.md). Off by default. This is only the default: an admin can turn generation on or off at runtime from the semantic layer's Power BI reports tab, wherever Assistant:Anthropic:ApiKey is set. Independent of Assistant.Enabled above, but reuses Assistant:Anthropic's ApiKey/Model, so enabling this requires that key to be set even if the interactive chat assistant itself is off.

Retrieval._comment: Matching a typed question against the stored ones (POWERAI.md Section 6): an LLM expands the question into related business vocabulary, then the stored questions are ranked by how many of those terms they match, using SQL Server's full-text index where the instance has one and a LIKE scan where it does not. Off by default and independent of both settings above. Needs no vendor of its own: the ranking is the database's, and ExpandSynonyms reuses Assistant:Anthropic's key/model (set ExpandSynonyms false to search the typed words alone with no LLM call or key). RankThreshold is how many terms a question must match to be called trusted rather than a loose lead; one shared term is often coincidence, two rarely is.
